title: Strix Halo / Halogen
description: Halogen 0.18.0 native aggregate telemetry. Processing speed is distinct from wall-time throughput, and pool occupancy is a completed-request snapshot.

options.content: **Native metrics, not a token-by-token live trace.** Counters advance on completed requests. Occupancy includes warm held regions and reflects the last completed request, not the current prompt's context. Engine probe is liveness, not a separate model-readiness check. Cache snapshots older than 15 seconds are hidden. [Host memory dashboard](/d/strix-halo-host).

panels.title: Metrics scrape
panels.description: Prometheus HTTP collection health. Down does not distinguish engine shutdown, network failure or authentication failure.

targets.expr: up{job="halogen"}

panels.title: Engine probe
panels.description: Halogen's last engine liveness probe, also used by /health. Not a promise that a new request can be admitted. Failed metrics scrape makes this unavailable, not definitely stopped.

targets.expr: halogen:engine_up{job="halogen"} and on(job, instance) (up{job="halogen"} == 1)

panels.title: Requests in flight
panels.description: Front-end request gauges, not generated token progress.

targets.expr: (llamacpp:requests_processing{job="halogen"}) and on(job, instance) (up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:engine_up{job="halogen"} == 1)
(llamacpp:requests_deferred{job="halogen"}) and on(job, instance) (up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:engine_up{job="halogen"} == 1)

panels.title: Oldest request age
panels.description: Zero when idle, not a latency distribution.

targets.expr: (halogen:busy_for_seconds{job="halogen"}) and on(job, instance) (up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:engine_up{job="halogen"} == 1)

panels.title: Processing speed over completed requests
panels.description: Tokens divided by summed engine processing seconds in the rate window. Not wall-time throughput or current-request speed. Uses counters, avoiding the native since-last-scrape gauges that can be consumed by other scrapers. No completed work is unavailable, not zero speed.

targets.expr: ((rate(llamacpp:prompt_tokens_total{job="halogen"}[$__rate_interval]) / rate(llamacpp:prompt_seconds_total{job="halogen"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(job, instance) (rate(llamacpp:prompt_seconds_total{job="halogen"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:engine_up{job="halogen"} == 1)

((rate(llamacpp:tokens_predicted_total{job="halogen"}[$__rate_interval]) / rate(llamacpp:tokens_predicted_seconds_total{job="halogen"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(job, instance) (rate(llamacpp:tokens_predicted_seconds_total{job="halogen"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:engine_up{job="halogen"} == 1)

panels.title: Aggregate wall-time throughput
panels.description: Rate of completion-accounted token counters per wall second, including idle time. Short completed requests can appear as bursts. Cached prompt tokens are not newly processed tokens.

targets.expr: (rate(llamacpp:prompt_tokens_total{job="halogen"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(job, instance) (up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:engine_up{job="halogen"} == 1)
(rate(llamacpp:tokens_predicted_total{job="halogen"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(job, instance) (up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:engine_up{job="halogen"} == 1)
(rate(halogen:prompt_tokens_cached_total{job="halogen"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(job, instance) (up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:engine_up{job="halogen"} == 1)

panels.title: Pool positions, last completed request
panels.description: Pool capacity is not the maximum context of a single request. Occupancy includes warm held conversations and is not live current-prompt occupancy. Reservations include prompt plus maximum output requests, admitted or not.

targets.expr: (llamacpp:kv_cache_tokens{job="halogen"}) and on(job, instance) (up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:engine_up{job="halogen"} == 1)
(halogen:kv_pool_positions{job="halogen"}) and on(job, instance) (up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:engine_up{job="halogen"} == 1)
(halogen:kv_pool_reserved_tokens{job="halogen"}) and on(job, instance) (up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:engine_up{job="halogen"} == 1)

panels.title: Pool occupancy, last completed request
panels.description: Engine-held positions divided by pool capacity. Snapshot can remain unchanged while idle or during a long request.

targets.expr: (llamacpp:kv_cache_usage_ratio{job="halogen"}) and on(job, instance) (up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:engine_up{job="halogen"} == 1)

panels.title: Waiting for pool room
panels.description: State gauge, not accumulated wait time.

targets.expr: (halogen:kv_pool_waiting_for_room{job="halogen"}) and on(job, instance) (up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:engine_up{job="halogen"} == 1)

panels.title: Request and cache activity
panels.description: Rates are reset-aware. Cache and front-end counters have different reporting paths, so they need not match at every scrape.

targets.expr: (rate(halogen:requests_total{job="halogen"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(job, instance) (up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:engine_up{job="halogen"} == 1)

(rate(halogen:cache_hits_total{job="halogen"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(job, instance) (up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:engine_up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:cache_stats_age_seconds{job="halogen"} < 15)

(rate(halogen:cache_misses_total{job="halogen"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(job, instance) (up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:engine_up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:cache_stats_age_seconds{job="halogen"} < 15)

(rate(halogen:cache_disk_hits_total{job="halogen"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(job, instance) (up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:engine_up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:cache_stats_age_seconds{job="halogen"} < 15)

panels.title: Cache retention, fresh snapshots
panels.description: Engine-reported retained bytes, not measured RAM usage or disk-directory du. Cache bytes are not guaranteed disjoint from pool memory. Do not add these to GTT or engine allocations.

targets.expr: (halogen:cache_bytes{job="halogen"}) and on(job, instance) (up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:engine_up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:cache_stats_age_seconds{job="halogen"} < 15)

(halogen:cache_disk_bytes{job="halogen"}) and on(job, instance) (up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:engine_up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:cache_stats_age_seconds{job="halogen"} < 15)

(halogen:cache_disk_budget_bytes{job="halogen"}) and on(job, instance) (up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:engine_up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:cache_stats_age_seconds{job="halogen"} < 15)

panels.title: Cache snapshot age
panels.description: Background report age. Cache panels hide readings at 15 seconds or older, a local display policy, not an upstream freshness guarantee.

targets.expr: (halogen:cache_stats_age_seconds{job="halogen"}) and on(job, instance) (up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:engine_up{job="halogen"} == 1)

panels.title: Cache entries, fresh snapshot
panels.description: Retained engine cache records, not entry capacity.

targets.expr: (halogen:cache_entries{job="halogen"}) and on(job, instance) (up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:engine_up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:cache_stats_age_seconds{job="halogen"} < 15)

panels.title: Cache request hit share
panels.description: Hits divided by hits plus misses within the rate window, not token-cache share. Unavailable when no measured cache requests.

targets.expr: ((rate(halogen:cache_hits_total{job="halogen"}[$__rate_interval]) / (rate(halogen:cache_hits_total{job="halogen"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(halogen:cache_misses_total{job="halogen"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on(job, instance) ((rate(halogen:cache_hits_total{job="halogen"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(halogen:cache_misses_total{job="halogen"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:engine_up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:cache_stats_age_seconds{job="halogen"} < 15)

panels.title: Draft acceptance share
panels.description: Accepted proposals divided by all proposals in the rate window. Includes draft-head and prompt-lookup proposals together. Unavailable with no draft proposals, not zero.

targets.expr: ((rate(halogen:draft_tokens_accepted_total{job="halogen"}[$__rate_interval]) / rate(halogen:draft_tokens_total{job="halogen"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(job, instance) (rate(halogen:draft_tokens_total{job="halogen"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0)) and on(job, instance) (up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:engine_up{job="halogen"} == 1)

panels.title: Speculative proposal throughput
panels.description: Completion-accounted proposals per wall second. Acceptance does not establish a speedup against autoregressive decoding.

targets.expr: (rate(halogen:draft_tokens_total{job="halogen"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(job, instance) (up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:engine_up{job="halogen"} == 1)
(rate(halogen:draft_tokens_accepted_total{job="halogen"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(job, instance) (up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:engine_up{job="halogen"} == 1)

panels.title: Token counters, since front-end start
panels.description: Current counter totals, not lifetime across restarts. Rate charts handle decreases as resets. Engine cache-clear epochs remain unspecified.

targets.expr: (llamacpp:prompt_tokens_total{job="halogen"}) and on(job, instance) (up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:engine_up{job="halogen"} == 1)
(halogen:prompt_tokens_cached_total{job="halogen"}) and on(job, instance) (up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:engine_up{job="halogen"} == 1)
(llamacpp:tokens_predicted_total{job="halogen"}) and on(job, instance) (up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:engine_up{job="halogen"} == 1)

panels.title: Cache savings and eviction activity
panels.description: Separate sources, not summed. Cache saved and front-end cached counts may have different epochs and update times.

targets.expr: (rate(halogen:cache_prompt_tokens_saved_total{job="halogen"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(job, instance) (up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:engine_up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:cache_stats_age_seconds{job="halogen"} < 15)

(rate(halogen:prompt_tokens_cached_total{job="halogen"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(job, instance) (up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:engine_up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:cache_stats_age_seconds{job="halogen"} < 15)

panels.title: Cache evictions
panels.description: Counter of entries the cache forgot. Not a complete breakdown of dropped, superseded, refused or full/partial matches.

targets.expr: (rate(halogen:cache_evicted_total{job="halogen"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(job, instance) (up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:engine_up{job="halogen"} == 1) and on(job, instance) (halogen:cache_stats_age_seconds{job="halogen"} < 15)
